{{Quote|Neoglith masquers. The concept is similar. But I use tissues of species native to this galaxy. Nor are they complete organisms unto themselves, as ooglith masquers were. They have no brains, they do not suffer. When the nutrients suffusing their tissues are absorbed, they die&mdash;they do not propagate as species.|Viull Gorsat|<ref name="MercyKill" /> }}
'''Neoglith masquers''' were a variant of [[ooglith masquer]] created by [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Viull Gorsat]] around [[44 ABY]]. The masquers were created from genetic material found in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and they were not complete organisms in the same way that ooglith masquers were having no distinct [[Brain/Legends|brains]] and therefore did not suffer. The neoglith masquers could also not propagate as a species, and [[Death/Legends|died]] once the nutrient in their tissues were absorbed.<ref name="MercyKill" /> 

Gorsat was able to craft custom masquers disguising himself and other members of the squadron as other [[Human/Legends|Humans]], including a perfect copy of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], and a fictional [[Species/Legends|species]] created from [[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]] genetic samples found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="MercyKill" />
